simple.meaning: מִקְוֶה (miqveh) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 1:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, blood, kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִקְוֶה (H4723) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מִקְוֶה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מִקְוֶה (miqveh) / H4723 is tracked through Genesis 1:10, Exodus 7:19, Leviticus 11:36, 1 Kings 10:28. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection , i.e. (of water) a pond , or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove
definitions.usage: abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.
definitions.full: H4723. miqveh קוא only in מִקְוֵא see II. מִקְוֶה below II. קוה . קֹוֶה , or קֹוֵא proper name, of a territory Kuë in Cilicia (compare KAT 2. 257 ); מִקֹוֶה from Kuë , for מִקְוֵה ᵑ0 1Kin 10:28 (twice in verse) and || מִקְוֵא 2Chr 1:16 (twice in verse); so Wkl Alttest. Unters. 173 Gr Benz Kit, compare ᵐ5 ἐκ Θεκουε (also ἐκ Κωα Field Hexapla i. 616 ), ᵑ9 de Coa , Κωδ Lag Onom. 273 , Jerome Coa Id. ibid. 111 . I. מִקְוֶה noun [masculine] hope ; — absolute ׳מ 1Chr 29:15 ; Ezra 10:2 ; construct in phrase יִשְׂרָאֵל מִקְוֵה , epithet of ׳י Jer 14:8 ; 17:13 , compare 50:7 . II. [ מִקְוֶה ] noun [masculine] collection, collected mass (P); — construct מִקְוֵךְ Gen 1:10 ( מִקְוֶה also 1:9 , for מָקוֺם according to ᵐ5 Ball), Exod 7:19 ; Lev 11:36 , all of water. ׳מ ֯ 1Kin 10:28 (twice in verse) = מִקְוֵא 2Chr 1:16 ( company of merchants; drove of houses), see קֹוֶה
